dedupe_keys.name: hava kalitesi istasyon olcum sonucları web servisi

description: Hava Kalitesi İstasyon Ölçüm Sonuçları Web Servisi is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Department of Environmental Protection and Development. Bu web servis ile Id’si girilen istasyonun başlangıç ve bitiş tarihine göre Konsantrasyon (Concentration) ve Hava Kalitesi Index (AQI) bilgileri paylaşılmaktadır. Coverage: Department of Environmental Protection and Development. The publisher named on the listing is Department of Environmental Protection and Development. Its keywords include hava, hava kalitesi, hava kalitesi ölçüm, hava kalitesi ölçüm sonuçları, web servis. The listing shows 3 download or service links in API, PDF. The listing shows 2024-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
